independence_boundary: Separate delegated computational reviewer in the shared workspace; not external human approval or separate physical infrastructure.

blocking_canary_dependency.note: Values read from the preserved canary QA, not recomputed from raw RF by this source reviewer. The separate canary audit owns raw-RF verification.
blocking_canary_dependency.production_guard: load_locks rejects canary.status != PASS as PRODUCTION_BLOCKED_CANARY_NOT_PASS before reading the production plan or calling native.initialize/acquire_pose.

source_findings.finding: Exactly eight ordered contract canaries are required; every planned new pose must form the unique 909-pose complement of 0..916. Canonical raw paths and canary NPZ hashes are checked. Assembly requires exactly 917 unique sorted pose IDs.

The canonical production-spec hash excludes only production_audit and production_spec_sha256. The audit binds that spec, runner, contract and canary hashes; the final plan hashes the audit bytes. This avoids an audit/spec hash cycle. A separate production PASS receipt and a FROZEN plan are required.

Shard mode calls the unchanged V2 native.initialize/acquire_pose for the frozen pose list. Original Native LoS and Full calls, frequency grid, banks, material and source-code guards remain inherited. This driver does not substitute SourceFFD for Native LoS.

Assembly checks per-pose NPZ and metrics hashes, rebuilds every total H from preserved complex a and tau at each frequency, recalculates CIR/FP/selected-port observations, checks delay and unique Full direct-ray parity, validates source-column consistency and the continuous-range offset, then enforces all-917 RMS/max/tap/port gates.

Shard and assembly outputs must use new nonoverlapping directories. Complete per-pose raw files remain in their acquisition directories. Handled acquisition errors preserve completed records and native partial arrays; handled assembly errors retain checked-source lineage. Aggregate failure saves metrics and a raw-file ledger before refusing a PASS channel manifest.

The program handles ordinary Exception failures for one shard. It is not a multi-process supervisor, and signal termination/KeyboardInterrupt recovery was not reviewed or tested as a guaranteed ledger path. Any future parallel plan needs explicit process supervision and global-stop behavior.

Assembly consumes the hash-protected acquisition FD records and saved source arrays; it does not independently rerun the SourceFFD model or finite differences. This is raw consistency validation, not a replacement for a separate model/FD audit.

remaining_requirements: Resolve the P0 canary HOLD through the applicable separately reviewed protocol; preserve the failed run and locked tolerance.
Before any future production, freeze a complete measured-cost/partition plan and obtain a new independent audit bound to its exact spec and source bytes.
Verify actual production raw arrays and post-run provenance only if production is subsequently authorized and completes.
P2/P3 and scientific manuscript claims remain unavailable under the current HOLD.
